column1: # tests/expected/dead_leg_unjudged.tsv — #310 group 7 (14z-221): per row, a gate's control mode and the class
# tests/lib/classify.sh vs_classify_control must give its run with a dead emulator (MAME_BIN=/usr/bin/false), read by
# tests/test_dead_leg_unjudged.sh. Batch 1: the gates with one PRESENT mode in the 14z-215 re-census
# (build/agent215/t310/census57/group7.tsv, local) whose dead-emulator run read HONOURED at HEAD d3e8810d
# (build/agent221/t310g7/base/classes.tsv, local), and audit_dispatch_census's drift-clock (read LIES: a PASS on 0 legs).
# Each row's gate carries `# #310 g7 NJ` on the lines that make it UNJUDGED; the gate's nj-stripped control removes them.
# Batch 2 (14z-221c): the four candidates whose dead-emulator baseline DIED on a traceback (audit_pyron_ring,
# audit_tech_roll, test_down_flash_mechanism, test_random_select_tenants: each read a leg's missing output; each now checks
# its legs first), audit_column_flash under its current mode name (the baseline ran the census's flash-gone, renamed
# flash-planted at 14z-216, so it read REFUSED), test_dualtrack on a dead FBNeo (its leg is FBNeo; its NOT JUDGED lines,
# printed in plain runs too since 14z-215, became vs_ctl_nj), and four group-7 gates with two PRESENT modes that are not
# and two that are (audit_phobos_dmg_residual, audit_tick_phase: their rows there need a PILOT re-trace),
# one row per mode. The fifth column names the instrument made dead with /usr/bin/false (MAME_BIN is always dead too).
# A batch-2 stripped class is the neutered copy's measured class: the copy keeps the new liveness checks, so where the
# baseline DIED it reads HONOURED (the pre-fix gate's own class is the baseline's, build/agent221/t310g7/base/classes.tsv).

column4: stripped class (the gate with its NJ lines neutered)
